summary: Iteration 53 - Bank Reconciliation & Messaging Delivery Status. All 32 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all 19 accounting tabs visible and Bank Recon tab fully functional. Messaging delivery_status field working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Bank Reconciliation feature fully implemented with all endpoints working
GET /api/accounting/bank-accounts/{property_id} - auto-creates default account if none exists
POST /api/accounting/bank-accounts - creates new bank account with all fields
POST /api/accounting/bank-transactions/import - imports CSV transactions with deduplication
GET /api/accounting/bank-transactions/{property_id} - lists with month and matched filters
GET /api/accounting/bank-reconciliation/summary/{property_id} - returns match rate, bank vs system comparison, discrepancy
WhatsApp/Telegram/Email channels attempt real API calls when credentials configured
Without credentials, returns 'sandbox' or 'failed' status appropriately
Frontend Bank Recon tab shows: Match Rate, Bank vs System Comparison, Auto-Match button, Import CSV dialog, Add Transaction dialog

All 19 accounting tabs present: P&L, Night Audit, Income, Expenses, Invoices, Payments, Journal, AR Aging, AP Aging, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, Forecast, VAT, Recurring, Trends, Budget, CoA, Audit Trail, Bank Recon
seed_data_creation: Test bank transactions created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 completed full testing of Bank Reconciliation and Messaging delivery_status features. All bank reconciliation endpoints are on /api/accounting/ prefix. Use property_id 'aldgate-flats' for testing. The 19 frontend tabs are: P&L, Night Audit, Income, Expenses, Invoices, Payments, Journal, AR Aging, AP Aging, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, Forecast, VAT, Recurring, Trends, Budget, CoA, Audit Trail, Bank Recon. Auto-match tries to match bank transactions against payments, income entries, expense entries, and invoices by amount and date. Message send now returns delivery_status field (sandbox if no credentials, delivered if API call succeeds, failed if API call fails, internal for non-channel messages).

new_endpoints_tested.notes: Returns match rate, bank vs system, discrepancy

mocked_apis.notes: WhatsApp/Telegram/Email outbound calls are REAL HTTP calls but will fail/sandbox without user API keys configured in Channel Settings. Review platform reply sync (Google/Booking.com/TripAdvisor) attempts real API calls but will log 'skipped' or 'failed' without credentials.
